turns.agent_response:
The Ignite tier (2,500 Tier Credits) includes a 10% bonus on Momentum Point earn rates and priority restaurant seating. At the Leap tier (10,000 TC), you gain complimentary valet parking and preferred hotel rates. If you reach Ascend (25,000 TC), the benefits include room upgrades, a 50% bonus on earn rates, and access to a dedicated host.

Your blackjack play earns points that you can spend directly on dining, hotel stays, or retail shops throughout the property. Based on your weekend frequency, you may also be eligible for complimentary appetizers or desserts at participating casual dining spots. Insider tip: if you're looking for a quieter place to use those dining credits on a busy weekend, Michael Jordan’s Steak House often has more availability for bar seating where you can get the full menu.
